rows.headline: Using parking lot funds to preserve purchasing power
rows.hook: Liquidity tools for short-term capital deployment
rows.summary: This article discusses parking lot funds designed to help investors maintain their purchasing power in the short term. These financial instruments allow retail participants to keep unallocated cash earning returns while awaiting better market opportunities. For Indian retail investors, parking surplus cash in liquid or ultra-short-duration funds helps combat inflation without locking up capital. Such strategies are particularly useful during periods of equity market volatility when capital preservation is prioritized.
rows.why_it_matters: Idle cash earns returns while waiting for market dips.

This procedural guide matters to salaried Indian retail investors and workforce members whose retirement corpus and pension eligibility depend on timely employer deposits.

rows.hook: Traffic fines block vehicle registration and renewals
rows.summary: Unpaid traffic challans will now restrict essential vehicle services including Registration Certificates, Pollution Under Control certificates, and vehicle transfers following a Supreme Court order. The directive aims to enforce compliance and reduce pending traffic fine collections across transport authorities. Vehicle owners with pending challans will face blocks on routine renewals and transfers until dues are cleared. For Indian retail investors and vehicle owners, this increases administrative compliance and requires clearing pending dues before any vehicle sale or official paperwork.

rows.hook: Unresolved global trade issues cloud the outlook
rows.summary: NITI Aayog member Arvind Virmani kept India's FY GDP growth projection at 7% while citing a wider uncertainty range of plus or minus 1% due to global developments and trade issues. The 7% baseline keeps India among the fastest-growing major economies, offering strong corporate earnings visibility. rows.headline: Why relying solely on corporate health insurance is risky
rows.hook: Gaps await when employer health covers end
rows.summary: Relying only on employer-provided health insurance exposes families to financial risks during job transitions, unemployment, or retirement. Corporate policies typically lapse when you leave an organization, leaving older individuals or those between jobs uninsured. Buying an independent retail health policy ensures continuous coverage regardless of employment status. Retail investors should evaluate their personal medical coverage to avoid depleting savings during a medical emergency.
rows.why_it_matters: Personal medical costs could wipe out your savings during job loss.
rows.winners_losers: Retail insurers gain / uninsured employees hurt
